name: OBIS LX/LS

specs.Wavelengths: 375-980 nm (LX diode); 488-594 nm (LS optically pumped); over 30 wavelengths
specs.Output power: up to 365 mW (LX), up to 200 mW (LS)
specs.Modulation: LX: 150 MHz digital / 500 kHz analog; LS: 50 kHz digital / 100 kHz analog
specs.Beam / coupling: M² ≤ 1.2 (LX), ≤ 1.1 (LS); fibre-pigtailed PM single-mode FC/APC versions

summary: Compact single-wavelength laser modules with a common footprint, sold free-space or fibre-pigtailed. Widely used as excitation lines in confocal, TIRF and single-molecule setups and in multi-line combiners.

name: iBeam smart

specs.Modulation: optional external digital modulation up to 250 MHz

summary: Single-mode diode laser module available at many wavelengths from the UV to the near infrared. Used as a single excitation line or built into OEM instruments and microscopes.

name: Cobolt 04-01 Series (e.g. Cobolt Jive 561 nm)

specs.Output power: up to 400 mW (532 nm); Jive 561 nm 100-200 mW
specs.Modulation: optional integrated modulation up to 3 MHz

summary: Single-frequency diode-pumped lasers at fixed visible and near-infrared lines, including the yellow-green 561 nm and 594 nm lines that diodes cover poorly. A common source for exciting red fluorescent proteins in confocal and super-resolution microscopes.

name: Cobolt 06-01 Series

specs.Wavelengths: 375-1060 nm (06-MLD diode, 06-DPL DPSS at 532-594 nm, 06-HPLD high power)
specs.Output power: 06-MLD 488 nm up to 300 mW; 06-HPLD up to 1200 mW
specs.Modulation: up to 100 MHz, digital or analog

summary: Compact modulated laser family mixing diode and diode-pumped modules in one housing format. Suited to fluorescence excitation where fast on/off switching is needed, such as confocal scanning and single-molecule localization.

name: LuxX+

specs.Modulation: digital > 250 MHz; analog > 3 MHz; electronic shutter > 500 kHz

summary: Diode laser modules with fast direct modulation, used as single excitation lines and as the building blocks of Omicron's LightHUB combiners. Figures are from an older press release; current models extend the range.

name: FlexxRay (LBX/LCX/LPX)

specs.Wavelengths: 375-1064 nm (LBX diode 375-522 nm and red/NIR; LCX/LPX DPSS e.g. 532 nm)
specs.Modulation: up to 150 MHz (LBX direct); DPSS via AOM 3 MHz

summary: Oxxius's compact CW and modulated laser line, combining directly modulated diodes (LBX) with DPSS lasers (LCX/LPX) in one footprint. Used for confocal, super-resolution and flow cytometry, and as sources for Oxxius combiners.

name: iChrome MLE

specs.Wavelengths: up to 4 lines (3 diode + 1 DPSS), 405-640 nm
specs.Modulation: analog and digital, up to 20 MHz on all lines
specs.Beam / coupling: PM single-mode fibre, FC/APC standard; automatic alignment (COOLAC)

summary: Four-line laser combiner delivering into one polarisation-maintaining single-mode fibre. Aimed at spinning-disk, light-sheet and super-resolution (STED, SIM, PALM/STORM) microscopes.

name: CELESTA Light Engine

specs.Output power: 400-800 mW per laser at the fibre end
specs.Modulation: TTL switching ~100 µs; intensity via serial
specs.Beam / coupling: SMA or FC/PC fibre; despeckled multimode output

summary: Seven-laser illuminator with high power per line delivered through a despeckled fibre. Built for photon-hungry widefield and spinning-disk methods such as MERFISH, DNA-PAINT, SMLM and optogenetics.

sources.title: Lumencor CELESTA Light Engine data sheet, document 54-10043

name: L6Cc (MixxWave combiner)

specs.Modulation: analog DC-1 MHz; TTL rise ≤ 2 ns (LBX) / ≤ 300 ns (AOM)
specs.Beam / coupling: free space or SM/PM/MM fibre, up to 4 output ports

summary: Modular combiner that merges up to six Oxxius lasers into one aligned beam or several fibres, controllable from µManager. Suits confocal, TIRF, light-sheet and FRAP setups that need several excitation lines.

sources.title: Oxxius MixxWave wavelength combiners brochure (via Photonic Solutions)

name: LightHUB Ultra

specs.Modulation: analog up to 1.5 MHz; digital on/off (<1 µs switching)
specs.Beam / coupling: 1 or 2 fibre outputs, PM single-mode or multimode

summary: User-upgradable laser engine holding up to seven diode or DPSS modules coupled into one or two fibres. Used to feed confocal and other fluorescence microscopes with several lines.

sources.title: Omicron LightHUB Ultra datasheet 01.2019 (via Quantum Design Europe)

name: LU-N4 / LU-N4S / LU-N3 Laser Units

specs.Output power: 15 mW at the fibre end (LU-N4S 488 nm: 8 mW)

summary: Compact pre-aligned four-line laser unit with an AOTF, made for Nikon TIRF, photoactivation and confocal systems.

name: Chameleon Discovery NX

specs.Output power: 3600 mW at 800 nm; >3500 mW at 1040 nm

summary: Widely tunable femtosecond laser with a second synchronised 1040 nm beam and built-in dispersion precompensation. Used for two-photon imaging of many fluorophores, deep in vivo imaging, SHG/THG and CARS/SRS.

name: Mai Tai HP / eHP
summary: One-box tunable Ti:sapphire oscillator, available with DeepSee dispersion precompensation for microscopy. A long-standing source for two-photon fluorescence imaging in the 690-1040 nm window.

name: Axon
summary: Compact, air-cooled fixed-wavelength femtosecond lasers with dispersion precompensation. The 920 nm version suits two-photon imaging of GFP and GCaMP indicators; 1064 nm suits red probes and SHG.

name: FemtoFiber ultra 920

specs.Wavelengths: 920 nm (optional SHG unit: >0.1 W at 460 nm)
specs.Modulation: integrated AOM for power modulation and flyback blanking
specs.Beam / coupling: free space; optional hollow-core PM fibre delivery (ultra FD)

summary: Fixed-wavelength femtosecond fibre laser at 920 nm for two-photon microscopy of GFP and GCaMP, with built-in fast power modulation and optional fibre delivery.

name: 775 nm Pulsed Fiber Laser
summary: Pulsed visible and near-infrared fibre lasers; the 775 nm model is used as a depletion source for STED microscopy of red and far-red dyes.

sources.title: MPBC Pulsed Fiber Lasers (100 ps-100 ns)

name: pE-300ultra

specs.Coupling: Direct fit or 3 mm liquid light guide

summary: A three-channel broad-spectrum LED illuminator that replaces a mercury or metal-halide lamp on a widefield fluorescence microscope. Suits routine multi-colour imaging with fast TTL-triggered switching.

sources.title: pE-300ultra | LED light for microscope | CoolLED

name: pE-800

specs.Control: USB 2.0, RS-232, 8 TTL + global TTL, 8 analogue inputs (0-10 V)

summary: An eight-channel LED illuminator with individually controlled channels from UV to far red. Suits automated multi-colour live-cell imaging where channels are switched by camera triggers.

name: pE-4000

specs.Control: USB, 4 TTL inputs, 4 analogue inputs (0-10 V), manual pod

summary: A four-channel LED source where each channel picks one of 16 LEDs, so the wavelengths can be matched to the filter sets in use. Suits labs with varied fluorophores including near-infrared dyes.

name: SPECTRA Light Engine

specs.Output power: ~0.5 W per colour band at end of 3 mm LLG
specs.Control: TTL trigger inputs for all eight sources

summary: A multi-colour solid-state source whose eight individually addressable outputs come from LEDs, luminescent light pipes and lasers cleaned up by bandpass filters. Suits fast multi-channel widefield and spinning-disk imaging.

name: SOLA SM II / SE II

specs.Channels: 5 solid-state sources combined to white light
specs.Output power: ~3 W white light at output of 3 mm LLG
specs.Control: USB, TTL on/off, tablet (Bluetooth), front-panel switch, foot pedal

summary: A solid-state white light source used as a drop-in replacement for a mercury or metal-halide lamp; wavelength selection is left to the microscope's filter cubes. Suits routine widefield fluorescence.

sources.title: Specifications | Sola | Light Sources | Nikon Instruments Inc.

name: X-Cite XYLIS II

specs.Control: speedDIAL, TTL (BNC), USB, RS-232, foot pedal

summary: A broad-spectrum LED illuminator meant as an arc-lamp replacement on compound and stereo microscopes, delivered through a light guide. Suits routine fluorescence from DAPI to Cy7.

name: X-Cite NOVEM
summary: A nine-channel LED illuminator with a motorised filter changer for the 500-600 nm band; model variants add Fura-2 (340 nm) or IR800 (785 nm) excitation. Suits multi-colour imaging, slide scanning and ratiometric calcium imaging.

name: X-Cite 120Q

specs.Coupling: Liquid light guide with microscope adaptor

summary: A pre-aligned 120 W mercury vapour short-arc lamp in a remote housing that feeds the microscope through a liquid light guide, avoiding lamp alignment and heat at the stand. A common pre-LED widefield fluorescence source. Availability not confirmed by a current manufacturer page.

name: ZEISS Colibri 7

specs.Channels: Up to 7 excitation lines from up to 6 LEDs
specs.Control: ZEN software, control panel, microscope TFT, hardware triggers

summary: A filtered multi-LED source that mounts directly on ZEISS microscopes, with a lime LED plus motorised filter giving green or yellow lines. Suits fast multi-colour live-cell imaging under ZEN control.

name: D-LEDI
summary: A four-LED fluorescence illuminator for Nikon microscopes with fanless cooling and pre-centred LEDs. Suits routine DAPI/GFP/RFP/Cy5 imaging with software-controlled intensity.

sources.title: D-LEDI | Light Sources | Nikon Instruments Inc.

name: Lumen 300-LED

specs.Coupling: Direct fit or optional liquid light guide
specs.Control: Manual keypad, TTL on/off, 0-100% in 1% steps

summary: A broad-spectrum white LED source for fluorescence excitation, used with the microscope's own excitation filters. Suits routine widefield fluorescence as a mercury-lamp replacement. Availability not confirmed by a current manufacturer page.

name: HBO 100 W/2
summary: A 100 W DC mercury short-arc bulb, the classic source in microscope epi-fluorescence lamp housings; its strong mercury lines suit DAPI, FITC and TRITC excitation but it needs alignment and frequent replacement. Availability not confirmed: OSRAM product links now lead to Ushio.

sources.title: OSRAM Technical Information FO 4225: HBO 100 W/2 (copy)
